name: Sunken Temple: the Sanctum dragons appear only after the Avatar of Hakkar and Jammal'an die
contract: On Ascension the four Sanctum dragons (Morphaz 5719, Weaver 5720, Dreamscythe 5721, Hazzas 5722) appear only
once the Avatar of Hakkar 8443 and Jammal'an the Prophet 5710 are dead. instance_sunken_temple hides the dragons
(invisible, passive, not selectable and immune to players) until both of those Eranikus wardens are killed, then
releases them. Each dragon is checked at its real spawn: nearby_creature_count confirms it is within the 60
yards the per-creature metrics read, nearby_creature_can_attack uses Player::IsValidAttackTarget and
nearby_creature_at_client reports whether the creature is in the player's client-visible set. Weaver
(-458.84/127.7) and Morphaz (-667.59/103.11) stand still; Dreamscythe walks a circle about 45 yards around
(-467/95) and Hazzas walks x -653 from y 7 to y 134, so their presence controls wait for them to come within
range. A Nightmare Wanderer 5283 spawn beside Weaver and the summoned Avatar beside Morphaz are visibility
controls: they reach the client, so a hidden dragon's 0 is not a visibility update that has not run yet. The
Avatar and Jammal'an are summoned in the hero's instance and cast Suicide (7) on themselves; any death of those
entries counts as a warden kill. The hero is a level 60 human player (not a GM, who would see hidden creatures)
with a health fixture, so the released dragons cannot kill them. Weaver and Dreamscythe spawn in phase 2 and
their SmartAI moves them to phase 1 on load, so the hero joins phases 1 and 2 to see the real spawns wherever
they are; a scenario in the normal world phase runs exclusively.

steps.label: Let the character finish logging in
The hero enters Sunken Temple beside Weaver and Dreamscythe
CONTROL: the hero is inside Sunken Temple
The hero sees the normal world phase and phase 2, where the real dragons spawn
CONTROL: the Nightmare Wanderer beside Weaver is loaded
CONTROL: the Nightmare Wanderer beside Weaver reaches the hero's client
CONTROL: Weaver's spawn is loaded beside the hero
Weaver is hidden from the hero while both wardens live
Weaver cannot be attacked while both wardens live
CONTROL: Dreamscythe's patrol comes within range of the hero
Dreamscythe is hidden from the hero while both wardens live
Dreamscythe cannot be attacked while both wardens live
The hero moves to Morphaz and Hazzas
Summon the Avatar of Hakkar beside the hero
CONTROL: the summoned Avatar of Hakkar reaches the hero's client
CONTROL: Morphaz's spawn is loaded beside the hero
Morphaz is hidden from the hero while both wardens live
Morphaz cannot be attacked while both wardens live
CONTROL: Hazzas' patrol comes within range of the hero
Hazzas is hidden from the hero while both wardens live
Hazzas cannot be attacked while both wardens live
the Avatar of Hakkar casts Suicide (7) on itself
CONTROL: the Avatar of Hakkar dies
Morphaz is still hidden while Jammal'an lives
Morphaz still cannot be attacked while Jammal'an lives
CONTROL: Hazzas is within range after the Avatar's death
Hazzas is still hidden while Jammal'an lives
Hazzas still cannot be attacked while Jammal'an lives
The hero returns to Weaver and Dreamscythe
CONTROL: the Nightmare Wanderer is loaded again
CONTROL: the Nightmare Wanderer reaches the hero's client again
Weaver is still hidden while Jammal'an lives
Weaver still cannot be attacked while Jammal'an lives
CONTROL: Dreamscythe is within range after the Avatar's death
Dreamscythe is still hidden while Jammal'an lives
Dreamscythe still cannot be attacked while Jammal'an lives
Summon Jammal'an the Prophet beside the hero
Jammal'an casts Suicide (7) on itself
CONTROL: Jammal'an dies
Weaver appears to the hero once both wardens are dead
Weaver can be attacked once both wardens are dead
CONTROL: Dreamscythe is within range once released
Dreamscythe appears to the hero once both wardens are dead
Dreamscythe can be attacked once both wardens are dead
The hero returns to Morphaz and Hazzas
CONTROL: Morphaz is loaded beside the hero again
Morphaz appears to the hero once both wardens are dead
Morphaz can be attacked once both wardens are dead
CONTROL: Hazzas is within range once released
Hazzas appears to the hero once both wardens are dead
Hazzas can be attacked once both wardens are dead
